scenes.title: Deterministic 2D-to-1D Signal Recovery Architecture
scenes.subtitle: Spectral grid calibration, chromatic grid suppression, Huber Viterbi DP, and GTQI gating
scenes.narration: TraceGate combines 'spectral grid deskewing', local shadow normalization, and a Huber-regularized 'Viterbi dynamic programming' tracker with parabolic P-QRS-T fiducial delineation.

exploded_parts.name: Stage 1 · Spectral Grid Pitch & Deskew
exploded_parts.role: Recovers exact px/mm pitch and corrects planar rotation skew

exploded_parts.name: Stage 2 · Shadow & Chromatic Grid Filter
exploded_parts.role: Normalizes uneven phone shadows (+28.3 dB on MIT-BIH #112)

exploded_parts.name: Stage 3 · Global Viterbi DP Tracker
exploded_parts.role: Tracks steep R-wave upstrokes while ignoring text stamps (+30.9 dB)

exploded_parts.name: Stage 4 · GTQI Gate & Fiducial Calipers
exploded_parts.role: Withholds intervals on lead collisions or blank grids (GTQI < 65)

animations.text: Huber Slew Penalty Preserves Steep R-Peaks

scenes.title: GTQI Safety Gate Withhold & Benchmark Explorer
scenes.subtitle: Refusing Tier 5 colliding leads (GTQI 41/100) and inspecting the 120-strip benchmark
scenes.narration: When adjacent leads collide on Tier 5, our 'GTQI safety gate' scores 41 out of 100, boxes the artifact region, and withholds QTc intervals to prevent false alarms.

animations.subtext: Prevents false long-QT report on colliding V3/V4 leads
Interactive GTQI threshold slider (60% cov → 2.9ms QT MAE)

scenes.title: Quantitative Results & Honest Clinical Limitations
scenes.subtitle: 120-strip 5-tier benchmark (24 subjects) + 16-case external MIT-BIH validation
scenes.narration: Across 120 held-out strips and 12 real 'PhysioNet MIT-BIH' recordings, gated Viterbi achieves 2.9ms QT MAE at 60% coverage, while reporting honest single-lead and high-voltage boundaries.

metrics.label: Gated Waveform SNR (60% Coverage)
metrics.note: 95% CI [17.63–18.66 dB], RMSE 37.1 µV vs 107.8 µV Argmax

metrics.label: Gated QT Interval MAE (Clinical Units)
metrics.note: 95% CI [2.02–3.90 ms]; QRS MAE 3.5 ms; HR MAE 0.12 BPM

metrics.label: Real PhysioNet MIT-BIH Cohort Mean SNR
metrics.note: 12 real patient records (r = 0.9419, +8.64 dB over Argmax)

limitations: Research prototype — NOT a cleared diagnostic medical device; clinician must inspect cyan overlay.
Accuracy–availability trade-off: GTQI ≥ 65 lowers QT MAE from 9.6 ms to 2.9 ms by withholding 40% degraded/colliding strips.
On pristine 300 DPI scans (Tier 1), simple Column-Argmax (20.56 dB) slightly edges smoothed Viterbi (19.14 dB).
Single-lead 2.5s scope; extreme >3.2 mV PVCs (MIT-BIH #119) exceed 10 mm/mV height and require 5 mm/mV half-gain.
